title: "Preprocessing 25-26"
execute:

```{r}
#| include: false
library(tidyverse)
```

## Import Data

```{r}
path01 <- c("harmonized_data_short/2025_26/01_Общие_сведения.xlsx")
path02 <- c("harmonized_data_short/2025_26/02_Успеваемость.xlsx")

sheets01 <- readxl::excel_sheets(path01)
sheets02 <- readxl::excel_sheets(path02)

gen_info <- map(sheets01, \(x) readxl::read_excel(path01, sheet = x)) %>% 
  set_names(sheets01) %>% map(\(x) rename_all(x, str_replace, pattern = "^_", replacement = ""))
acad_perf <- map(sheets02, \(x) readxl::read_excel(path02, sheet = x)) %>% 
  set_names(sheets02) %>% map(\(x) rename_all(x, str_replace, pattern = "^_", replacement = ""))
```


## General Info

```{r}
nrow(gen_info$`Поток 1`)

gen_info$`Поток 1` %>% 
  filter(!is.na(Страна_и_город)) %>% 
  add_column(stream = 1) %>% 
  bind_rows(
    gen_info$`Поток 2` %>% 
      filter(!is.na(Страна_и_город)) %>% 
      add_column(stream = 2)
  ) %>% 
  add_column(year = "25/26") %>% 
  rename(
    "stud_id" = "ID учащегося",
    "pseudonym" = "Псевдоним",
    "location" = "Страна_и_город",
    "role_status" = "Должность_иили_год_обучения",
    "is_ib_alumni" = "Являетесь_ли_вы_выпускником_Института_биоинформатики",
    "prior_ib_events" = "На_какой_программе_Института_биоинформатики_вы_учились",
    "work_description" = "Расскажите_подробнее_о_вашей_работе_какими_исследованиями_занимаетесь_с_какими_проблемами_в_анализе_собственных_данных_сталкиваетесь",
    "data_analysis_exp" =  "Опишите_ваш_опыт_в_анализе_данных_с_какими_данными_вы_работали_для_каких_целей",
    "r_programming_exp" = "Опишите_ваш_опыт_программирования_на_R",
    "expectations" = "Что_вы_ожидаете_от_участия_в_программе",
    "future_application" = "Как_вы_планируете_применять_полученные_на_программе_знания_в_дальнейшем_",
    "info_source" = "Откуда_вы_узнали_о_программе",
    "comments" = "Любая_другая_информация_которой_вы_хотите_поделиться"
  ) -> gen_info_merged
```

Проверяем, что получилось.

```{r}
nrow(gen_info_merged)
all(gen_info$`Поток 1`$`ID учащегося` %in% gen_info_merged$stud_id)
all(gen_info$`Поток 2`$`ID учащегося` %in% gen_info_merged$stud_id)
```

Добавляем колонку с отчислением.

```{r}
gen_info$Отчисленные %>% 
  rename("is_expelled" = "Строка в источнике",
         "stud_id" = "ID учащегося",) %>% 
  right_join(gen_info_merged) -> gen_info_merged
```

Глядим.

```{r}
glimpse(gen_info_merged)
```


## Intro Exam

```{r}
all(colnames(acad_perf$`Stepik вступительный 1`) == colnames(acad_perf$`Stepik вступительный 2`))

all(acad_perf$`Stepik вступительный 1`$`ID учащегося` %in% acad_perf$`Stepik вступительный 2`$`ID учащегося`)

acad_perf$`Stepik вступительный 1` %>% 
  add_column(stream_stepik = 1) %>% 
  bind_rows(
    acad_perf$`Stepik вступительный 2` %>% 
      add_column(stream_stepik = 2)
    ) %>% 
  filter(!is.na(total)) %>% 
  rename(
    stud_id = "ID учащегося",
    pseudonym = "Псевдоним",
    intro_math_q1 = "Математика Q1",
    intro_math_q2 = "Математика Q2",
    intro_math_q3 = "Математика Q3",
    intro_math_q4 = "Математика Q4",
    intro_stat_q1 = "Статистика Q1",
    intro_stat_q2 = "Статистика Q2",
    intro_stat_q3 = "Статистика Q3",
    intro_stat_q4 = "Статистика Q4",
    intro_rprog_q2 = "Программирование на R Q2",
    intro_rprog_q3 = "Программирование на R Q3",
    intro_rprog_q4 = "Программирование на R Q4",
    intro_total_test = "total"
  ) -> stepik_intro
all(stepik_intro$stud_id %in% gen_info_merged$stud_id)
```

```{r}
glimpse(stepik_intro)
```

```{r}
all(colnames(acad_perf$`Отбор 1`) %in% colnames(acad_perf$`Отбор 2`))

acad_perf$`Отбор 1` %>% 
    add_column(stream_creative = 1) %>% 
  bind_rows(
    acad_perf$`Отбор 2` %>% 
        add_column(stream_creative = 1)
    ) %>% 
  rename(
    stud_id = "ID учащегося",
    pseudonym = "Псевдоним",
    intro_creative_task = "ТЗ"
  ) %>% 
  filter(!is.na(intro_creative_task)) -> creative_task
all(creative_task$stud_id %in% stepik_intro$stud_id)
nrow(creative_task)

stepik_intro %>% 
  full_join(creative_task, by = join_by(stud_id, pseudonym)) -> intro_exam

glimpse(intro_exam)

intro_exam %>% 
  summarise(n = n(),
            .by = c(stud_id, pseudonym)) %>% 
  filter(n > 1) -> intro_exam_doubles
  
intro_exam_doubles %>% 
  knitr::kable()

intro_exam %>% 
  filter(stud_id %in% intro_exam_doubles$stud_id) %>% 
  arrange(stud_id) -> intro_exam_doubles

intro_exam %>%
  anti_join(
    intro_exam_doubles %>% 
      filter(stream_stepik == 1)
  ) %>% 
  arrange(stud_id) -> intro_exam_clean

intro_exam_clean %>% knitr::kable()
```

## Courses

```{r}
acad_perf[-(1:5)] %>% names()
acad_perf[-(1:5)] %>% set_names(
  c(
    "tv_stat",
    "data_automation",
    "evidence_medicine",
    "medical_data",
    "data_viz",
    "data_management",
    "multivariate",
    "sample_size",
    "survival",
    "regulatory",
    "research_project"
  )
) -> courses
```


### Deadlines

```{r}
courses %>% names()
courses %>% 
  map(colnames) %>% 
  map(\(x) tibble(x = x)) %>% 
  imap(\(x, idx) x %>% mutate(ds = idx)) %>% 
  bind_rows() %>% 
  filter(str_detect(x, "ДЛ")) %>% 
  mutate(x = str_replace(x, "--", "–")) %>% 
  separate(col = x, into = c("task", "deadline"), sep = "–")
```

courses$tv_stat %>% colnames()
courses$tv_stat %>%

## Merge All

```{r}
gen_info_merged %>%
  full_join(intro_exam_clean) %>%
  full_join(grades_diploma) %>%
  full_join(tv_stat) %>%
  full_join(data_automation) %>%
  full_join(evidence_medicine) %>%
  full_join(medical_data) %>%
  full_join(data_viz) %>%
  full_join(data_management) %>%
  full_join(multivariate) %>%
  full_join(sample_size) %>%
  full_join(survival) %>%
  full_join(regulatory) %>%
  full_join(research_project) %>% 
  arrange(stud_id) -> full_data
full_data %>% nrow()
all(full_data$stud_id %in% gen_info_merged$stud_id)
```

```{r}
#| eval: false
#| include: false

full_data %>% write_csv("data/25-26/full_data_25-26.csv")
```

## Check & Fix `full_data`

```{r}
#| include: false

full_data$grade_tv_stats == full_data$tv_stats_grade
full_data$grade_tv_stats_a == full_data$tv_stats_grade_a
full_data$grade_multivariate == full_data$multivariate_grade
full_data$grade_multivariate_a == full_data$multivariate_grade_a
full_data$grade_evidence_medicine == full_data$evidence_medicine_grade
full_data$grade_evidence_medicine_a == full_data$evidence_medicine_grade_a
full_data$grade_data_viz == full_data$data_viz_grade
full_data$grade_data_viz_a == full_data$data_viz_grade_a
full_data$grade_data_management == full_data$data_management_grade
full_data$grade_data_management_a == full_data$data_management_grade_a
full_data$grade_sample_size == full_data$sample_size_grade
full_data$grade_sample_size_a == full_data$sample_size_grade_a
full_data$grade_regulatory == full_data$regulatory_grade
full_data$grade_data_automation == full_data$data_automation_grade %>% tolower()
full_data$grade_bioequiv == full_data$grade_bioequiv
full_data$grade_research_project == full_data$research_project_grade
full_data$grade_research_project_a == full_data$research_project_grade_a
full_data$stream == full_data$stream_stepik
```

```{r}
full_data %>% # colnames()
  mutate(
    is_expelled = is_expelled %>%
      str_replace("Да", "1") %>% 
      replace_na("0") %>% 
      as.numeric(),
    is_ib_alumni = is_ib_alumni %>% 
      str_replace("Да", "1") %>% 
      str_replace("Нет", "0") %>% 
      as.numeric(),
    prior_ib_events = ifelse(is.na(prior_ib_events), 0, 1),
    info_source_tgchat = info_source %>% str_detect("Телеграм"),
    info_source_lectorium = info_source %>% str_detect("лектории"),
    info_source_colleagues = info_source %>% str_detect("коллег"),
    info_source_selfsearch = info_source %>% str_detect("Самостоятельный"),
    data_automation_passed = data_automation_grade %>% 
      tolower() %>% 
      str_detect("^зачёт") %>% 
      as.numeric(),
    survival_hw_passed = survival_hw_grade %>% 
      tolower() %>% 
      str_detect("^зачёт") %>% 
      as.numeric(),
    regulatory_passed = regulatory_grade %>% 
      tolower() %>% 
      str_detect("^зачёт") %>% 
      as.numeric(),
  ) %>% 
  mutate(across(starts_with("info_"), as.numeric)) %>% 
  mutate(across(contains("hw"), as.numeric)) %>% 
  # select(
  #   -Псевдоним,
  #   -stream_creative,
  #   -stream_stepik,
  #   -work_description,
  #   -data_analysis_exp,
  #   -r_programming_exp,
  #   -expectations,
  #   -future_application,
  #   -comments,
  #   -info_source
  # ) %>% 
  select(
    year,
    stream,
    # location,
    # role_status,
    stud_id,
    pseudonym,
    is_expelled,
    is_ib_alumni, prior_ib_events,
    starts_with("info_"),
    starts_with("intro_"),
    tv_hw1,
    tv_hw2,
    stats_hw1,
    stats_hw2,
    tv_stats_score = tv_stats_sum_roundup,
    tv_stats_grade,
    tv_stats_grade_a,
    data_automation_passed,
    evidence_medicine_hw1,
    evidence_medicine_hw2,
    evidence_medicine_hw3,
    evidence_medicine_score = evidence_medicine_sum_roundup,
    evidence_medicine_grade,
    evidence_medicine_grade_a,
    medical_data_score = medical_data_grade,
    data_viz_hw1,
    data_viz_hw2,
    data_viz_hw3,
    data_viz_score = data_viz_roundup,
    data_viz_grade,
    data_viz_grade_a,
    data_management_hw_dm,
    data_management_hw_sp,
    data_management_score = data_management_sum_roundup,
    data_management_grade,
    data_management_grade_a,
    multivariate_hw,
    multivariate_grade,
    multivariate_grade_a,
    sample_size_hw,
    sample_size_grade,
    sample_size_grade_a,
    survival_hw,
    survival_hw_passed,
    regulatory_score,
    regulatory_passed,
    research_project_grade,
    research_project_grade_a
  ) %>% 
  mutate(across(ends_with("grade"), tolower)) -> full_data_fix
full_data_fix %>% glimpse()
```
